context: M25 o4. W 35th St off Eighth, rain on the windshield. Mayhew in the driver's seat. Teddy in the passenger seat. Same as 1971.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: Same spot. Same rain, almost. You remember?

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: I remember a man in a good suit in the back seat. With a briefcase.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: Lisle. A.D.A. then. Case seventy-one forty-four-oh-two. A trucker's assault charge.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: Lisle made it go away. For money. I carried. You drove. You were my alibi, kid.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: Then the Commission came. I gave them six guys so I'd never have to give them you. Or him.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: You gave them six so they'd never ask about one.

choices.text: Get out of the city, Carl.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Take your pension and go to Florida. Fish. Never come back to Thirty-Fifth Street.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Start the car, Carl. Fifth and Thirty-Sixth. She's always parked there.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: …Yeah. Okay. I always liked driving you.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: I waited in this car once and said nothing. Not twice.
